_comment: Example org policy override for the deterministic audit engine. Copy the `config` object below into your rule catalog (references/agent-audit-rules.json) or point AGENT_GOVERNANCE_RULES_PATH at a catalog that contains it. Every key is optional; absent keys fall back to the shipped defaults. thresholds/profiles override, vocabularies/patterns extend. See docs/checks-reference.md § Extending the checks. NOTE: narrowing profiles.security is intentionally omitted here — extend, do not weaken, the security gate.
